deviceToken: the same value you set as DEVICE_TOKEN in Vercel
cronSecret: (optional) the same CRON_SECRET, to nudge the Google poller more often than the daily Vercel cron
openaiKey: (optional) OpenAI key — only for the audio brain-dump parser (Whisper)

rules.message: You've been coding two hours — stretch and drink some water.

uh._comment: OPT-IN, LOCAL-ONLY grade scraper (WCJC Pioneer Portal -> Brightspace). Runs on YOUR machine with YOUR login from this local config; nothing touches the cloud except the parsed grades. Automating a portal login likely violates the school's terms of service — your account, your risk. Requires: npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium.

otp._comment: 2FA login code emailed to Gmail. Needs `npm install imapflow` and a Gmail APP PASSWORD (https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords, 2-Step Verification required) — NOT your normal Gmail password. Tick trustDevice so future runs skip the code.
